svg.title: Cool and collect the bottom product
svg.desc: Cool to room temperature and collect the product at the vessel bottom. The source does not report a cooling rate, numerical room temperature, washing, filtration or additional product-drying protocol. Conceptual geometry; no measured apparatus design.
